note: Scripture excerpts verified against churchofjesuschrist.org (2026-11-13). Each 'note' is AUTHORED DIALOGUE for the fictional Bednar game character — never a real quote.
noteLabel: A note from President Bednar (game character)

scripture.text: …seek ye out of the best books words of wisdom…

cards.note: The words you need are kept where students come to learn from the best books. Once you reach their home, read the building as carefully as a page.

hints.broad: Look at the library's south side, near the walkway.
hints.view: Stand on the walkway south of the library and face the wall — one tall column and two rounded bays.

cards.note: Look toward the house on the hill, where thoughts turn heavenward. Near its approach, two lines become one if you stand in the right place.

hints.broad: On the lawn north of the temple, beside the approach.
hints.view: Stand north of the lawn and look toward the temple: two hedge lines meet and continue as one.

scripture.text: …be one; and if ye are not one ye are not mine.

cards.note: A team learns to move as one where students train and compete. What seems separate from nearby may come together from farther away.

hints.broad: On the lawn south of the Hart Building.
hints.view: Step back south of the two curved walls until they line up into one shape.

cards.destination: Eliza R. Snow Performing Arts Center

scripture.text: For my soul delighteth in the song of the heart…

cards.note: Follow the music to where students perform. Amid many notes and voices, look for one line standing on its own.

hints.broad: By the Snow Building's south entrance, among the decorative poles.
hints.view: Most poles carry a round 'note' — find the plain column with a cap and a base.

assign.speaker: President Bednar
assign.text: {player}, it’s good to see you. The years have flown by, haven’t they? Look how much this campus has grown.

assign.speaker: President Bednar
assign.text: I have one more job for you. Four letters are hidden around campus, right in plain sight. These cards will help you find them.

assign.speaker: President Bednar
assign.text: Once you have them, bring them to the sign by the roundabout. Let’s finish it together.

dialogue.reminder: Keep those cards handy, {player}. Check your journal whenever you need a clue, and bring each letter to the sign by the roundabout.
